verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms usage-event recording for usage-based billing and multi-frequency subscription billing, which supports basic usage-plus-subscription models, but there is no documentation of tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, or hybrid pricing structures, nor of credits, commitments, or overage handling. missing for 10: explicit tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit pricing model docs, credit/commitment/overage handling documentation, no-code configuration evidence for these pricing types.
